playbook.intent: A month of unapproved commissions has piled up in the affiliate dashboard and the people who sent the business are starting to ask when they get paid. The hour is over when every row has been approved or rejected with a reason, the money has actually left the account with receipts behind it, the biggest referrers have heard from a human, and one change to the program is booked for next month.
playbook.scope: Monthly 1-hour ritual: pull affiliate and referral stats, approve commissions, pay out, message top referrers.

success-criteria.criterion: Affiliate platform stats and referral records reconcile against the dashboard, and anything that would not reconcile is written up rather than rounded away

Every commission carries a status of approved, rejected or pending, each rejection carries its reason, suspicious activity is flagged, and the approved payouts all show as sent with a receipt in the affiliate's inbox
The top three to five referrers of the month have a personal message and the promised perk in hand, and one adjustment to the commission rate, cookie window or copy sits in next month's calendar slot

stage.name: Approve / reject

tasks.task: Note the reason for any rejection

stage.decision-gate: Advance only when each row has a status.

stage.name: Run the payout
stage.intent: Send the money on the same day.

tasks.task: Send the payout receipt to each affiliate

stage.decision-gate: Advance only when every payout shows sent.

stage.name: Thank top referrers
stage.intent: Treat your distribution channel like family.

tasks.task: Offer a perk (early access, bonus, shoutout)

stage.decision-gate: Cycle closes when every top referrer is thanked.

stage.name: Tune the program

tasks.task: Decide one tweak (rate, cookie window, copy)

stage.decision-gate: Cycle closes when next-month tweak is queued.
